about: Custom-part requests for the in-browser model, each with what the built part must measure (scripts/mesh-metrics.mjs judge): size sorted smallest first (null = any), through-holes, hollow, pieces, a dim that must appear, fill: [lo, hi] share of the bounding box. Run the requests through the browser pipeline (see scripts/webllm-eval-check.mjs for the page runner), then judge the codes in Node.
